positions.as_written: Take the history: the lateral pain, the duration, whether there was a previous fracture or a previous lateral meniscectomy, and any inflammatory features.
Assess correctability with a varus force near extension, recording how much the alignment improves.
Assess the medial collateral ligament, since a long standing valgus knee stretches the medial structures.
Measure the range and record any fixed flexion separately, and look for an external rotation deformity, which accompanies valgus wear.
